result.answer:
The HKMA's updated guidance is anchored around three pillars that collectively form the acronym ART. [5]

The letter A stands for Accountability, described as ensuring clear ownership, governance, decision-making authority and assurance throughout the A.I. lifecycle. [4][5]

The letter R stands for Resilience, described as enabling secure, robust and well-controlled A.I. adoption that operates safely, fails safely and recovers effectively. [4]

The letter T stands for Trust, described as prioritising fair, transparent, explainable and privacy-conscious A.I. use that is responsive to customers and other affected parties. [4]
